tables.title: Population of Japan, 1945 and 1940 census
footnotes: a/ Excludes Okinawa Ken and Oshima Gun of Kagoshima Ken
tables.totals_check: Prefectures summed per district. 1945: Tohoku 8,268,023 = printed; Tokai-Hokuriku 9,831,975 = printed; Kinki 10,528,105 = printed; Chugoku 6,230,132 = printed; Kyushu 10,028,892 = printed; Hokkai single prefecture agrees; Kanto-Shinetsu sum 19,154,583 vs printed 19,754,583 (DISAGREE, 600,000); Shikoku sum 3,826,378 vs printed 3,836,378 (DISAGREE, 10,000). 1940: Tohoku, Kanto-Shinetsu, Kinki, Chugoku, Shikoku, Kyushu agree; Tokai-Hokuriku sum 9,228,604 vs printed 9,228,504 (DISAGREE, 100). Districts summed to Japan Proper total: 1945 = 71,996,477 and 1940 = 72,354,670, both agree with the printed totals.
warnings: Kanto-Shinetsu 1945: prefecture figures sum to 600,000 less than the printed district total; district total agrees with the grand total, so one or more prefecture cells were probably misread or misprinted (cell not identified).
Shikoku 1945: prefecture figures sum to 10,000 less than the printed district total (3,836,378, which agrees with the grand total).
Tokai-Hokuriku 1940: prefecture figures sum to 100 more than the printed district total (9,228,504, which agrees with the grand total).
Scan is low resolution; prefecture digits were read from the image and may contain misreadings.
tables.ocr_check: OCR was poor on this table (many wrong digits and misspelt prefecture names, e.g. Okinawa 374,279, Hokkaido 1940 3,572,718); transcription is from the image with spellings as printed.
